text.p: Sony Electronics Inc. said Tuesday it has introduced what it described as the world's smallest digital Handycam camcorder with a screen.

The Park Ridge, N.J.-based division of Japan's Sony Corp. said its DCR-PC7 Digital Handycam, which has a colour screen and viewfinder, will be available in November at a suggested list price of $3,199.

"This product ... offers even greater recording and playback options than ever before and is so small, it can fit in my shirt pocket," said said Jay Sato, a vice president with the company's Consumer Products Group.
Sony said the digital video format camcorder weighed about one pound without tape or battery and measured 2-1/4-inches wide, 5-1/2 inches high and 4-1/2 inches deep.
